cases.case_label: XDP SVA in TAF1 intron 32 (antisense) with variable hexamer
cases.mechanism_detail: The XDP-specific SVA inserted antisense in TAF1 intron 32 has a polymorphic CCCTCT hexamer (35-52 repeats) whose length inversely correlates with age at onset; reporter assays show the SVA modulates transcription and the authors propose transcriptional interference (RNAP II barriers, G-quadruplexes) reducing TAF1 transcription/altering splicing.
cases.quote: Within this cohort, the length of the SVA hexamer ranged from 35 to 52 repeats.
